authority.source_authority: DAD governs this candidate package; every enrolled repository retains authority over local CI adoption and exceptions.

non_overlap_statement: Only primary-writer edited tracked files; all scouts, the independent checker, and optimization reviewers remained read-only.

roles.why_needed: A low-cost inventory prevented duplicate lessons, skills, validators, and templates.
roles.mission: Find reusable overlaps and exact gaps in DAD CI and dependency surfaces.
inputs: DAD registries, lessons, workflows, assets, graphs, tests, and instructions
roles.authority: Read-only DAD inventory; no downstream content or edits.
acceptance_conditions: Exact paths and IDs support a dedupe conclusion.
stop_conditions: Search would require downstream content or mutation.

roles.why_needed: Provider-neutral CI contracts required medium-effort workflow and dependency synthesis.
roles.mission: Propose provider-neutral semantics, evaluator behavior, integration surfaces, and portability evidence.
roles.authority: Read-only advice; cannot edit or approve its own proposal.
acceptance_conditions: Design covers lanes, typed edges, fixtures, exceptions, and required-check deadlocks.
stop_conditions: Reviewed authority sources cannot resolve a conflict.

readiness_conditions: Existing surfaces and alternatives are compared.

roles.why_needed: A metadata-only inventory bounded migration without downstream reads or writes.
roles.mission: Identify enrolled-repository metadata, audit limits, and human-reviewed adoption routes.
roles.authority: Read-only DAD metadata; no downstream traversal or mutation.
acceptance_conditions: Findings state audit depth, evidence status, and the non-mutation boundary.
stop_conditions: A conclusion would require downstream workflow contents.

roles.why_needed: One writer kept schema, evaluator, fixtures, registries, navigation, skill, and scaffolds coherent.
roles.mission: Implement and repair the provider-neutral capability and deterministic evidence.
roles.authority: May edit only the isolated DAD worktree; no downstream or global changes.

readiness_conditions: Writer checks pass and exact workflow digests are current.

roles.why_needed: High-impact CI governance required independent false-positive and false-negative review.
roles.mission: Red-team the completed capability and independently verify repaired workflow-condition, body, branch, exception, and scheduling controls.
roles.authority: Read-only review; cannot edit writer output or grant execution authority.
acceptance_conditions: Requested risk classes are covered and the final verdict is PROCEED or a concrete repair.
stop_conditions: Evidence is incomplete or independence is compromised.

readiness_conditions: Raw permitted artifacts and results are available.

roles.why_needed: A full-suite timeout activated DAD's measured long-run review rule.
roles.mission: Measure the expensive pytest signature and decide whether algorithm, library, parallelism, or runtime changes are warranted.
roles.authority: Read-only optimization analysis; no code, dependency, runtime, or cache changes.
acceptance_conditions: Recommendation uses a stable baseline and names parity, rollback, and stop gates.
stop_conditions: Optimization would change scope or require a new dependency without evidence.

roles.why_needed: The long-run review required an independent check against optimizing an unstable timeout outlier.
roles.mission: Challenge the bottleneck evidence, cache-safety boundary, Rust/library escalation, and parity gates.
roles.authority: Read-only checker; no implementation or dependency changes.
acceptance_conditions: Reject unsafe current-state caching and unsupported runtime escalation.

proof_obligations.description: Prove suites follow ownership and dependency edges without unrelated blockers or silent broadening.
Prove provider neutrality and metadata-only human-gated adoption.
evidence_required: portable core and GitHub adapter cards

unresolved_decisions.summary: The full repository pytest command exceeded 604 seconds; a content-keyed Python validator-cache experiment is deferred to separate measured work.

reconciliations.reason: The inventory completed with no exact pre-existing capability and reusable adjacent assets.
The architecture contract was implemented with a provider-neutral core and explicit adapter.
The audit remained metadata-only and produced patch categories without downstream traversal.
The writer completed one bounded repair cycle after independent findings and preserved exclusive write ownership.
The checker first returned REPAIR, then independently returned PROCEED after exact digest and scheduling repairs.
A command exceeded the long-run threshold and activated the required optimization review.
An independent read-only check rejected an unstable baseline and unsafe cache or runtime escalation.
